commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+4' A lofted cross from Marcus Edwards (Burnley) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Burnley have a corner.
90+3' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+2' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Savinho (Manchester City) takes it short.

90+2' A terrific piece of skill by Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Martin Dubravka.

89' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Martin Dubravka pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right-hand post.
89' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
87' Scott Parker has decided to make a change. Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) replaces Jaidon Anthony.
87' Substitution. Marcus Edwards (Burnley) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Josh Laurent walks off.

86' Nico (Manchester City) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
85' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
85' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sprays a pass out to Erling Haaland, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
82' Scott Parker has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florentino (Burnley) replacing Bashir Humphreys.
82' Here's the change. Zian Flemming leaves the pitch and Armando Broja (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.

80' Ambitious effort from Erling Haaland (Manchester City). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
80' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) sends a chip pass into the box, but Martin Dubravka is quickest to intercept the ball.
79' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
78' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.
78' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
76' Zian Flemming (Burnley) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
75' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
72' Substitution. Loum Tchaouna makes way for Lyle Foster (Burnley).
71' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
71' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
70' The resulting corner from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is cleared by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.

70' He should have scored! Savinho (Manchester City) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Martin Dubravka makes an easy save. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
70' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 36:64.
66' Zian Flemming (Burnley) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
65' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Antoine Semenyo and he is replaced by Savinho (Manchester City).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Ait-Nouri leaves the pitch and Nico (Manchester City) comes on.
64' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) brings an opponent down and Andy Madley interrupts the game.
63' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
62' PENALTY APPEAL after Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
61' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
60' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by James Ward-Prowse (Burnley), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
59' A precise low pass is received by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
59' The attendance for today's match is 21259.
58' Manchester City are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post!
52' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
51' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) takes the corner which is cleared.
50' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
49' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
47' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Andy Madley has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
44' Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) controls the ball from the resulting free kick inside the six-yard box, but his effort is blocked by one of the defending players.
44' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

43' The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
40' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) whips in a cross from the corner, but Martin Dubravka is well positioned and punches the ball away.
36' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
35' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
32' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
32' Martin Dubravka (Burnley) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' A pass into the penalty area from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is intercepted by the defence. Manchester City earn a corner.
29' Zian Flemming (Burnley) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!

28' A sweet pass finds Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Martin Dubravka is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
26' A snap shot by Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Martin Dubravka produces a good save to thwart him.
25' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

25' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) rises above the defence and powers a header at the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a superb save. Manchester City force a corner. They send men into the box.
24' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) will take a corner kick.

24' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) and Rayan Cherki try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move. Corner kick. Manchester City will have an opportunity.
24' Josh Laurent (Burnley) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

19' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.

18' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Burnley are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
16' Zian Flemming (Burnley) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
15' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley).
13' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
9' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
8' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. Manchester City win a corner.
5' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Jeremy Doku tees up Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Martin Dubravka.

5' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) squanders an obvious chance to score! He was in a very good shooting position and aimed his attempt to the right side of the target. Martin Dubravka showed great goalkeeping skill to dive and deflect the ball onto the post.

3' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert and denies him with a nice save.
3' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
